info.title: cxagent — a coding agent for the terminal
info.description: A coding agent that works in your checkout: sub-agent delegation, a permission gate on every tool call, MCP servers, and resumable sessions. Bring your own model — Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible or Ollama.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: cxagent — a terminal AI coding agent

options.name: --model
options.description:
Start on a named provider instance from config.json instead
of the default. The status line shows which one is live.

options.name: --theme
options.description:
Start in a named theme, case-insensitive. An unknown name
falls back to 'cxagent' rather than refusing
to start. Available themes:
Amber, Crimson, cxagent, Daylight, Forest, ModernGray, Ocean, Slate

options.name: --config-dir
options.description:
Use DIR for config.json, history and session state instead
of the usual location. Useful for a throwaway setup that
leaves your real one alone.

options.name: --continue
options.description: Reopen the most recent session in this folder.

options.name: --resume
options.description:
Reopen that session. Without an id, the TUI starts with this
folder's sessions listed, to pick from.

options.name: --sessions
options.description:
List this folder's sessions and exit. 'all' lists every
folder's.

options.name: --mock
options.description:
Run against a scripted provider instead of a real model.
Nothing is sent anywhere and nothing is spent.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Print this and exit.
HEADLESS (one goal, no TUI — Claude Code's options)

options.name: --print
options.description:
Run GOAL and print the result. The goal may also come last,
after the options. With no text, stdin is the goal; with
text, piped stdin is attached to it.

options.name: --output-format
options.description:
text (the answer), json (one result object) or
stream-json (one event per line).

options.name: --include-partial-messages
options.description: With stream-json: text as it streams.

options.name: --max-turns
options.description:
Stop after N turns (exit 3).
--permission-mode M default or dontAsk (refuse what would prompt), acceptEdits,
auto, bypassPermissions.

options.name: --dangerously-skip-permissions
options.description:
Approve every prompt, except a file-tool write into a .git,
.vscode, .claude or .idea folder, anywhere. Shell commands
are approved like anything else, including ones that write
into those folders.

options.name: --trust
options.description: Trust this folder for this run only.

options.name: --plugin
options.description:
Load that configured plugin for this run, even one with
enabled: false (repeatable, or comma-separated);
--plugin none loads none.
Exit: 0 answered, 1 failed, 2 usage, 3 turn limit, 130/143 interrupted.
CONFIGURATION
Providers, agent types, MCP servers and permissions live in config.json under
your config directory. Run cxagent once with no configuration and it offers to
write one.
MORE
/help inside the app lists what you can type at the prompt.
https://github.com/nickprotop/cxagent
